title: Your care information, in one place
synthetic: Everything here is made-up demonstration data. It is not your real health record.
syntheticNotForMedicalUse: Everything here is made-up demonstration data. It is not your real health record and not for medical use.
subtitle: See the results and next steps your care team has shared with you.

about.title: About this demo
about.showsBody: Only results and next steps your care team has reviewed and released to you.
about.neverBody: It never gives a diagnosis or treatment advice, never shows a health score, and is never used for insurance or credit decisions.
about.contactBody: For questions about your care, talk to your care team at your health facility. In an emergency, go to your nearest health facility.

persona.title: Choose a demo persona
persona.intro: Each persona is a made-up person that shows one situation in the wallet.
persona.disclaimer: Demo persona — role switching is not real sign-in
persona.cardHint: Opens the wallet as this demo persona
persona.emptyBody: The demo data may be missing. Reset the demo to restore it.
persona.loadError: The demo personas could not be loaded.
persona.startError: This persona could not be opened. Nothing was changed. Try again.

verify.title: Confirm it is you
verify.intro: Enter the 6-number code to finish setting up your wallet.
verify.hintBody: In this demo the code is {{code}}. This is a simulated check — it does not confirm anyone's real identity.
verify.wrongCode: That code is not right. {{count}} attempts left.
verify.unavailable: Verification service is not available right now. Nothing was changed. Try again later.
verify.error: The code could not be checked. Nothing was changed. Try again.

recover.title: Get help at your facility
recover.body: Too many wrong codes were entered, so this wallet is locked. Your care team can unlock it and check who you are in person at the facility.
recover.contactBody: Reception desk, Demo Health Centre Alpha — open weekdays 07:00–17:00.

header.switchPersonaHint: Ends this demo session and returns to the persona list.
